name: press-mentions-list
title: Press mentions list
description: In the news as a dated list: outlet, headline and date per row, every headline a link, with an optional limit and a show-all button.
docs: Pass items ({ outlet, headline, date, href, excerpt? }), title, locale and timeZone for the dates, and limit to show that many rows with a 'Show all coverage' button. The date and outlet sit in the left column and the headline is the link, though the whole row is the click target; a full http(s) address opens in a new tab with an arrow and 'opens in a new tab' for screen readers, a relative one stays in the tab. A date-only string is a calendar date and never shifts with the time zone. labels translate the three fixed texts.
